title: SI — Your words. On your Mac.
description: An open-source input method for macOS. Chinese and English together, entirely on your Mac. Type offline, keep your original input, and choose what SI remembers. Development preview.
intro: Chinese and English, in the same flow. SI brings their candidates together and processes every keystroke locally. No internet connection needed for typing.
requirement: macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon / Intel · Free & open source
demoNote: A scripted illustration of selected candidates, not a live engine. Actual results and order can vary.
demoAccessible: Typing shi offers Chinese and English choices alongside the original input. Typing woxiangyaodeploy illustrates the mixed candidate 我想要deploy. Typing SI_build42 illustrates preserving the exact identifier with Return. Each example is a separate composition.
scene1Body: Type shi. Chinese matches, English completions, and the exact original share one list.
scene2Body: Type woxiangyaodeploy. A bounded Chinese/English path can bring 我想要deploy together.
scene3Body: Names, code, and new words stay intact. Return commits SI_build42 exactly as typed.
aboutEyebrow: Designed for the way you write.
feature1Body: Enable English and Simplified Chinese once. Candidates from both stay available, including ambiguous matches. There is no active-language mode to switch.
feature2Title: The original is always an option.
feature2Body: Keep capitalization, identifiers, and unfamiliar words exactly as you entered them. Your original input remains a candidate, even with all languages disabled.
feature3Title: Make room for your own phrases.
feature3Body: Add personal phrases and choose your own short codes. Edit, import, export, or delete them in Settings, independently of optional app learning.
previewLabel: A development preview. Built in the open.
previewBody: SI currently supports English and Simplified Chinese, with bounded Pinyin and mixed decoding. Vocabulary quality, ranking, and host-app compatibility are still being validated. The demo illustrates possibilities, not guaranteed results in every app.
downloadEyebrow: A quieter kind of input method.
downloadBody: Free, open source, and ready to type offline after installation. Choose the development preview for your Mac.
releaseStatus: Choose the version for your Mac’s chip. Open the DMG, then run Install SI.pkg. Save your work before the installer’s final Log Out step, then log back in and add SI under English in Keyboard settings.
footerLine: One input. Entirely on your Mac.
arm64SourceLabel: Source for the Apple Silicon version
artLabel: A little space for every thought.
offlineBody: On a flight, away from Wi-Fi, or simply in your own space. SI’s dictionaries and input processing live on your Mac. Typing keeps working offline.
offlineGraphicLabel: Input is processed inside your Mac to produce local candidates without an internet connection.
privacyPoint1Body: No cloud inference, analytics, or keystroke logging. No account needed to type.
privacyPoint2Body: App vocabulary and app history have separate opt-ins. Both start off; you can inspect, pause, or delete saved app data.
privacyPoint3Body: Only a manual update check contacts the download service. It sends no typed content or personal phrases.
